objective: Add non-terminal Quest v2 soft targets while preserving hard-deadline expiry, rewards, the Neon ledger owner, the existing action gate, permission gates and backward compatibility.

roles_before.artifact: Hard deadline automation and EXPIRED semantics.
No hard deadline means no automatic expiry.
Verified completion exclusively controls progression rewards.
Neon system_events is the mutable derived-state owner.
system_apply_action validates and idempotently applies writes.
PWA is read-only projection including System notifications.
Base SHA is the pre-change rollback point.

role_dispositions.destination: Soft targets never auto-terminalize a quest.
Soft-target automation can only push notifications; it cannot award or remove XP/coins.
Target declarations use existing notification.pushed ledger events with versioned source_ref; no second store.
No SQL/action-gate/schema change; declarations/reminders use existing notification.push.
Setting/rescheduling a soft target remains exact-authorization gated.
Existing notification surface displays declaration/reminder/missed messages; core quest projection is unchanged.
Base SHA remains complete rollback provenance.

capability_probes.assertion: Hard deadlines still expire once server-side.
Passing a soft target creates at most notification events and cannot create FAILED, EXPIRED or reward events.
Quests without soft-target declarations remain unchanged.
Newest valid declaration wins while previous declarations remain audit history.
A soft target later than a hard deadline is ignored by automation.
Profile, skills, attributes, achievements, shop, strategy context, auth and atomic quest resolution remain unchanged.
